dreams.text: find the sea where every fish in the world swims together
make Admiral before forty
draw a map of the whole world
open an inn of their own by the harbour
be the finest blade their island ever raised
find the treasure at the end of the Grand Line
buy back the family farm
see their island free of whoever rules it
build a ship that can sail anywhere
live long enough to hold their grandchildren
cook a dish the whole sea talks about
find a cure for the sickness that took their mother
be the richest merchant in the four Blues
read the stones nobody is allowed to read
stand on an island in the sky
find the one who wronged them and settle it
captain a crew of their own
be someone children tell stories about
grow old somewhere quiet by the sea
find the one who sailed away and never wrote

be the strongest there is
see the day nobody has to fight

agree: Very well. You have my agreement.
I see no reason to refuse.
refuse: I am afraid I must decline.
That will not be possible, I regret to say.
annoyed: I would ask you not to do that again.
angry: I will not be spoken to in that manner.
laugh: You have a gift for amusement, I grant you.
scared: Let us not be hasty, I beg you.
There is no need for that, surely.
moved: I hardly know what to say.
That means more to me than I can express.
evasive: I would rather not discuss it.
threat: I would advise you most strongly against it.
You will find me a poor enemy to make.
sad: Forgive me. It has been a difficult season.
warm: It is good to see you. Truly.
You are always welcome at my table.
proud: I believe I have earned that.
I did only what was proper.
sorry: That was badly done of me.
challenge: Then let us settle it properly.
Name the place. I shall be there.
tease: Is that the best you can manage?
doubt: I find that difficult to credit.
Forgive me if I remain unconvinced.

angry: Say that again and I'll break your face.
laugh: Hah. You're a real piece of work.
scared: Alright, alright! No need for that.
threat: Try it and see what happens.
You want a fight? You'll get one.
sad: Don't want to talk about it.
warm: Good to see your ugly face.
Sit down, I'll get you a drink.
proud: Course I did. Who d'you think you're talking to?

refuse: Aww, sorry, I can't do that one!
laugh: That's the funniest thing all week!
grateful: Thank you thank you thank you!
You're the best, you know that?
moved: Waaah, you're going to make me cry!
That's so sweet I can't stand it!
evasive: Let's talk about something fun instead!
threat: I'm smiling, but I mean it. Don't.
You really don't want to see me angry.
sad: Sorry, I'm not much fun today.
It's okay. I'll be okay. Probably.
warm: It's always better when you're around!
proud: Did you see that? Did you see?
I did it! I really did it!
sorry: My bad, my bad! Forgive me?
tease: Is that a blush? It's a blush!
doubt: Hmmm, are you sure about that?

refuse: Nay. That I will not do.
angry: Thou shalt answer for that insult.
By my blade, thou goest too far.
scared: Stay thy hand, I pray thee.
moved: Thou honourest me beyond my worth.
evasive: That is not for thine ears.
threat: Cross me and rue the day.
Thou wouldst not survive mine anger.
sad: There is grief in this house.
warm: Thou art ever welcome by my fire.
proud: None other could have done it.
sorry: I have wronged thee. Forgive me.
challenge: Draw, then, and let steel decide.
tease: Is that the best thou hast?
doubt: Thy tale hath holes in it.

angry: That's not fair and you know it.
moved: I don't know what to say.
threat: Don't make me do something about it.
warm: It's really good to see you.
doubt: I'm not sure I believe that.

warm: ...It is not unpleasant to see you.
sorry: I was wrong. It will not happen again.

milestones.label: Friend
milestones.line: {name} counts you a friend now.

milestones.label: Close friend
milestones.line: Somewhere along the way, {name} became one of your closest friends.

milestones.label: Falling out
milestones.line: You and {name} have drifted into a cold silence.

milestones.label: Together
milestones.line: There is no pretending any more: you and {name} are together.

milestones.label: A quarrel
milestones.line: {name} has had enough of waiting for word from you, and says so.

milestones.label: A break-up
milestones.line: It is over between you and {name}.

milestones.label: Nakama
milestones.line: {name} is nakama now: whatever comes, {they} will stand with you.

milestones.label: Desertion
milestones.line: {name} has had enough of you and your ship.

milestones.label: Devoted
milestones.line: {name} would follow your teaching anywhere.

milestones.label: Graduation
milestones.line: {name} has learned all you can teach. From today, {name} stands alone.

milestones.label: A secret taught
milestones.line: {name} takes you aside and shows you something nobody else has been shown.

milestones.label: A blessing
milestones.line: {name} gives you {their} blessing, and with it something {they} carried for years.

milestones.label: Patience lost
milestones.line: {name} throws up {their} hands: you are wasting {their} time.

milestones.label: Nemesis
milestones.line: {name} is no longer your rival. Your nemesis, now.

milestones.label: Rival and friend
milestones.line: Somewhere between the bruises, {name} became a friend as well as a rival.

milestones.label: A blessing
milestones.line: {name} tells you {they} could not be prouder of you.

milestones.label: Estrangement
milestones.line: {name} no longer speaks your name at home.

milestones.label: A recommendation
milestones.line: {name} puts your name forward, with a word that carries weight.

milestones.label: A protégé
milestones.line: {name} has become your protégé in all but name.

milestones.label: Mutiny
milestones.line: {name} will not take another order from you.

milestones.label: Loyal to the end
milestones.line: {name} would face anything for you now.
